verdict.rationale: The Microsoft Graph API officially supports posting a new chatMessage to a specified channel (ms-teams-docs-11, ms-teams-docs-21), and the Export APIs can read channel messages (ms-teams-docs-13). Microsoft also documents external services and bots calling the Teams API to automate scenarios and take part in conversations (ms-teams-docs-19, ms-teams-docs-20), so the core read/post story is covered. Community feedback that integration requires the full Azure/Graph stack is a friction complaint, not a contradiction (ms-teams-comm-11). missing for 10: evidence of scoped tokens or granular permission scopes for channel read/write, a documented standard channel-messages read endpoint beyond the export APIs, and independent hands-on corroboration.
